children: UK neuroscience imaging firm's FY26 revenue expected to rise 28% yr/yr to £8.3 mln
Year-end order book increased to £16.0 mln, supporting future revenue visibility
Year-end cash rose after £9.4 mln capital raise completed in April 2026
Company expects FY26 revenue of £8.3 mln, exceeding previous guidance of £8.0 mln
IXICO says FY26 EBITDA loss expected to improve versus previous guidance of £1.7 mln loss
Company enters FY27 with strong order book and expects continued growth momentum
NEUROSCIENCE DEMAND - Co said revenue growth was driven by increased demand for specialist neuroimaging and biomarker analytics capabilities
NEW CLINICAL TRIALS - Co said it secured new clinical trial programmes and expanded relationships with existing customers
STRATEGY EXECUTION - CEO said disciplined execution of Innovate, Lead, Scale strategy drove strong demand for neuroimaging capabilities
